issues.issue: What is the appropriate standard of review?
issues.respondent_position: Reasonableness is the appropriate standard of review.
issues.result_quote: Assessments of the adequacy of state protection raise questions of mixed fact and law and is also reviewable against a standard of reasonableness

issues.issue: Did the Board err in rejecting the claim, by misstating the state protection test and weighing the evidence?
issues.applicant_position: Board misstated the state protection test (serious efforts, not actual effectiveness), ignored evidence of police failure and weighed documents unfairly.
issues.respondent_position: Test is whether protection was adequate; Board weighed the evidence and reasonably found no clear and convincing evidence of inadequate protection.
issues.result_quote: This decision is unreasonable because it conflicts with the Dunsmuir above
